confirmedLeftStockRollingGain.scope: Main Bus Roll containing the dry-surface bank replacements. Separate debris/rattle feed Shader Roll too.
confirmedLeftStockRollingGain.deltaFilterCorrection: Delta11/Filter12 feeds cabin rattle and impacts. Roll_V is direct suspension amplitude, not suspension velocity/roughness.

otherStockInputs.trigger: Speed and WaterDepth conditions multiplied; no invented interpretation of native numeric condition enum
otherStockInputs.Tires_Surface_SIG: Speed interpolation 0..35 followed by power/crossfade produces Roll_Slow_V/Roll_Fast_V; this SIG does not read categorical surface material
otherStockInputs.APCDynamicRange: Speed custom dB curve and Surface condition Is Not Above Ground multiply into Roll_V; native private wheel values not yet observed
otherStockInputs.outsideOcclusion: Interior/control/coverage/room/water related stock mix; no candidate gain or camera settings altered

supportedExplanation: FAILED01 preserved the suspension-dependent tire gain chain when replacing samples. That swap does not provide a continuous tracked-vehicle mechanism. At zero suspensionFrontLeft that bus is attenuated by 60dB before its other gains.
